messages:
Sara: quick proposal: switch low-latency routes to an EWMA-based per-route sampler + a console 'inspect' grant flow. current global sampler spikes during bursts and skews quota math. want ops + legal + devex opinions.

Mike: how light/heavy is the runtime change? do we add extra hops?

Sara: runtime change is tiny: sample decision still local. add controller that tracks recent qps and token-rate using EWMA. no extra RPCs. smoothing window 60s, alpha 0.3, floor 0.1%, cap 20%. also emit route.sample_rate metric.

Alex: console implications: need clear affordances for inspect. propose per-route inspect button that grants a short-lived token (ttl 10m), creates an audit entry, and shows who requested it. default off. manual slider for dev override (dev flag only).

Tara: product question: default adaptive on or off for new tenants? risk of surprise capture.

Jessica: legal input: audit log required, ephemeral retention for raw payloads, HMAC pseudonymization for user identifiers, org-admin opt-in for inspect in private deployments, retention cap 30 days.

Sara: sample config we'll ship as feature flag:

```
{
  "route": "/v1/generate",
  "sampling": {
    "mode": "ewma",
    "alpha": 0.3,
    "floor_pct": 0.001,
    "cap_pct": 0.2,
    "budget_tokens_per_min": 250000
  },
  "inspect": {
    "enabled": true,
    "ttl_seconds": 600,
    "audit_log": "true"
  }
}
```

Sara: runtime will export metrics: route.sample_rate, route.sampled_tokens, route.inspect_grants. billing/forecasting uses those.

Mike: ops note: add fallback to static sampler if controller crashes and emit incident metric; also enforce RPM hard-cap to protect storage on misconfig.

Alex: UI telemetry: show last 24h effective sample rate, inspect grants count, last grant owner, and who toggled overrides.

Tara: rollout plan: 1) flag for internal/system routes only, 2) console read-only metrics for a week, 3) opt-in for dev teams to enable inspect, 4) widen to customers after legal + small canary.

Jessica: I can sign off after HMAC hooks and retention policy are in the PR. add pseudonymization lib to the repo and update docs.

Sara: will open RFC + PR with e2e test and HMAC plugin link.

deploy-bot: canary scheduled 2025-09-01T03:00Z rolling to 10% of routes with flag `ewma-sampler`.

Mike: will watch route.sample_rate dash and alert on token spend anomalies or 5xx spikes. :thumbsup:

Alex: i'll post mockups for the inspect tile later today.

Tara: adding to the rollout checklist.

Sara: thanks everyone, follow-ups in RFC thread.
